text: {"items":[{"prompt":"When a user clicks a link to view a blog post at /blog/5/, what must the client include in the HTTP request for the server to know which post to display?","kind":"mcq","options":["The post ID in the URL path","A session cookie storing the last viewed post ID","The server automatically remembers the last post viewed","An Authorization header"],"correct_answer":"The post ID in the URL path","problem_type":"http-statelessness","distractors":{"The server automatically remembers the last post viewed":"server-remembers-requests"}},{"prompt":"After submitting a comment form via POST to /blog/5/comment/, which of the following is true about the server's knowledge of the user's previous GET request to /blog/5/?","kind":"mcq","options":["The server must receive the post ID again in the POST data","The server can infer the previous page without any data","The server uses a hidden field to remember the previous URL","The server relies on a cookie to track the previous request"],"correct_answer":"The server must receive the post ID again in the POST data","problem_type":"http-statelessness","distractors":{"The server can infer the previous page without any data":"server-remembers-requests"}},{"prompt":"If a user refreshes the page at https://example.com/blog/12/, what does the server need to know to return the same content?","kind":"mcq","options":["The URL path containing the post ID","The server remembers the last response it sent","A session variable storing the last viewed post","An API token in the header"],"correct_answer":"The URL path containing the post ID","problem_type":"http-statelessness","distractors":{"The server remembers the last response it sent":"server-remembers-requests"}}]}
